# Introduction

This week is focused on applying the tools and concepts learned so far to a small individual data science project.

# Learning goals

1. Develop and refine the mini individual project plan 

2. Learn how to inspect data and clean data accordingly

3. Learn about evaluating model performance of a classification algorithm

4. Practice organizing code, data, and project workflows

5. Get feedback and troubleshoot project challenges

# Lecture - ML and AI project flow

Introduction to machine learning and artificial intelligence, focust on the different steps needed to get to a final poster presentation

# Lab - Work on Mini Individual Project

Dedicated hands-on time for project development, troubleshooting, and instructor support. The focus this week lies on data inspection and data cleaning. 

# Discussion - Creating your first labeling algorithm and evaluating its performance

Create a labeling algorithm hands on based on the people in the class and use the pruned version of this model to learn about model performance evaluation such as accuracy, confusion matrix , sensitivity/specificity etc. 

# Assignment

Submit a progress update on your mini individual project.

# Looking ahead

The mini project will prepare you for the **larger team-based final project**. We will soon introduce the expectations for working with real farm data and collaborating with farmers.
